I've always found comfort in solving problems, even if other things like history or computer science make me feel a bit disconnected or frustrated.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes. Even though I love math, I can feel my heart racing when things get too complex or unfamiliar. My high neuroticism score makes me worry about making mistakes or not understanding something deeply. But when I focus on the logic, it helps calm me down. It's a mix of excitement and a bit of fear that I try to balance through practice and patience.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't really used AI to help with math learning yet. I prefer traditional methods like textbooks and talking through problems with friends or family. My low conscientiousness means I sometimes procrastinate, so I like straightforward resources. However, I'm open to trying new tools if they could make things easier and less stressful for me.
